instruction: Change the permissions of directory 'todo_list_Jan_1' to make it read-only (permission 555).

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing directory permissions to read-only. Evaluator uses stat command to get permissions and verifies they match 555. Custom metric validates permission value.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts directory permissions using 'stat -c '%a'' command which returns octal permission string
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter as rules dictionary and accesses 'expected_permissions' field
String comparison logic is appropriate for permission validation (exact match required)
Expected value '555' is semantically correct for read-only permissions (r-xr-xr-x)
Edge case handling: command returns empty string if directory doesn't exist, which correctly fails validation
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the single requirement (directory permissions = 555)
No postconfig needed: file permissions are persistent and don't depend on UI state
